news_items.headline: NL MVP Debate: PCA vs. Shohei Ohtani, Skubal Trade Conspiracies & The Good, Bad, and Uggla
news_items.summary: Jake Mintz and Jordan Shusterman examine Pete Crow-Armstrong's case for National League MVP against Shohei Ohtani following the Cubs' sweep of the Dodgers, while reviewing the rest of baseball's major award races. They dive into the mailbag to tackle Tarik Skubal trade conspiracy theories, front-office competitive mindsets, Washington Nationals fan despair, and Babe Ruth myths. To wrap up, they deliver "The Good, The Bad, and The Uggla,” spotlighting the Red Sox's 13-inning thriller, Jefry Yan’s leaping debut celebration, Harrison Bader's scooter mishap, and Dave Dombrowski using RBIs to defend Alec Bohm.
